svg.text: Phase 1: self-hosted core with a thin demo Web UI. The multi-tenant hosted SaaS is Phase 2+ over the same code.
SELF-HOSTED: everything inside this frame runs on the user's machine
the LLM never decides the tier (DEC-13)
runtime grounding judge on every paid answer
full Act mirror; judged norms; reified HLEG
Neo4j optional: browsing + n10s RDF export
the graph and project evidence never leave the machine in self-hosted mode
judges: Anthropic Claude, an independent model
config from .env, never hardcoded; degraded envelope if absent
Full structural mirror; deep extraction only on the high-risk core. The v1 poster query is kept as a regression fixture over the regenerated graph.
MULTI-TENANT HOSTED SaaS on Rahti (CSC, EU), same service layer and graph
Only transport, auth, and tenancy change. Core code stays identical.
Stack: Python + FastAPI + FastMCP + Neo4j (n10s RDF export) + Next.js demo UI + Docker Compose; OpenAI generator, Anthropic judges; AGPL-3.0
Spec: docs/architecture.md; references: docs/references.md; visual system: DESIGN.md; agent rules: AGENTS.md. Regenerate: scripts/make_architecture_diagram.py
